edits.old: - The legacy message IDs and their texts stand in the message map; no new message text is written here.
edits.new:
- The legacy message IDs and their texts stand in the message map; no new message text is written here.
- Unsettled element names carry the placeholder, and one review row marks each for the contract owner; a correction of an element name is a patch and a change of shape is a new version. The tag `v1` is gated on the contract tests and the schema lint (GAP-2504).

edits.old: and its schema is inherited and not restated.
edits.new: and its schema is inherited and not restated. rwb-payment writes the local decision record in its own transaction and publishes it; rwb-decision holds the package, its rows and its test cases, collects the records, appends them to the central hash-chained ledger and runs JOB-14, and evaluates no payment, writes no proceeds row and moves no plan state. One DecisionRecorded shape and one consumer group are used; the decision codes are the values of LOV-DECISION; inputs_ref is an opaque reference to the payment facts of the business date; the parameter key of the input age limit is a placeholder read through DP-06; the default page and size of the decision-log read are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2494) and are published with the read. PaymentMissed and ProceedsMatched carry the three data fields the legacy story names for each, with the CloudEvents envelope of the platform library; TreatmentBooked names no data field and carries the envelope only until one is named; a business field added later requires a new schema version (GAP-1347).

edits.new: (5) Run the nine contract tests, tag `v1` and publish the tag; test AC6 and AC7. Every threshold, count and limit of the deployment (replica counts, partition count, retention, alert thresholds, aggregation window, backfill limit and rollback) is a value of the environment and is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2505); the five runbook entries are reviewed with the on-call rota before promotion.
